noSignal: There's no cell service at Lapland Lake. Join the free Wi-Fi to call or text.

doors.name: Lounge
doors.detail: Seating, wood stove, restrooms, stairs to the café. Step-free ramp.

doors.name: Shop & Register
doors.detail: Buy passes and rentals, retail shop, lodging check-in.

doors.name: Rentals
doors.detail: Rental exit, and where you return rental gear.

doors.name: Wax Room
doors.detail: Wax benches in winter. Outdoor games in summer. Phone.

spots.name: Porta-Johns (winter)
spots.description: Outside, around the left corner of the building past door 1. Handy when you don't want to take your boots off.

spots.name: Tables & Gear Cubbies
spots.description: Picnic tables by the sunny windows. Store your gear in the cubbies and eat your lunch here. Recycling is just inside door 1.

spots.name: Wood Stove Lounge
spots.description: Warm up by the wood stove on the leather couch, chair and loveseat.

spots.name: Restrooms
spots.description: Straight back from door 1, down 2 steps: a women's restroom and a restroom for men and all. More restrooms upstairs by the café.

spots.name: Lodging Guest Sauna
spots.description: Wood-fired Finnish sauna with a shower. For lodging guests only.

spots.name: Stairs to the Café
spots.description: Just inside door 1, to the right: the white door leads up two short flights of stairs to the café.

spots.name: Retail Shop
spots.description: Lapland Lake apparel, hats, socks, skis, boots and snowshoes for sale. Enter through door 2, or from the lounge.

spots.name: Register
spots.description: Pay here for day passes, rentals and shop items. Bought online? Give your name here to pick up your ticket and rental form.

spots.name: Lodging Check-In
spots.description: The reservation desk, up one step at the back of the shop. Check in and out of your lodging here.

spots.name: Rental Counter
spots.description: Hand in your size form and get your skis, boots, poles or snowshoes. Then head out door 3.

spots.name: Wax Room
spots.description: Door 4, always open. Wax benches with outlets in winter (bring your own iron). Outdoor games to borrow in summer. Landline phone and message board.

spots.name: Top of the Stairs
spots.description: Coming up from the lounge, the café opens up in front of you.

spots.name: Drink Fridge
spots.description: Cold drinks, yogurt, sandwiches and salads. On your right at the top of the stairs.

spots.name: Café Counter
spots.description: The Kuuma Feeding Station: soups, hot dogs, baked goods, coffee and hot chocolate. If nobody is at the counter, pay at the shop register downstairs.

spots.name: Restrooms
spots.description: Two restrooms, to the right of the café counter.

spots.name: Café Seating
spots.description: Plenty of tables to eat and warm up.

rentalSteps: Pay at the register inside door 2 (or pick up your online order there). You'll get a size form.
Fill in the form, then walk past the register to the rental counter.
Hand in the form and get your equipment.
Head out door 3. Please carry your skis to the trail, not through the parking lot or road.
When you're done, return everything at door 3 (Rental Returns).
goodToKnow: Door 1 has a step-free ramp. The café upstairs is only reachable by stairs.
In winter, porta-johns are outside, around the left corner of the building past door 1.
Beginners: walk across the road to start on the Lake Trail. West side trails start between the garage and the lodge.
Taking a lesson? Meet your instructor inside door 2.
